page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-performance parallel computing tasks. Built on x86_64 architecture, it features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz with 24 physical cores and 48 vCPUs using dedicated KVM virtualization. The system is equipped with 368.0 GB of RAM, offering 7.67 GB of memory per core. Compute capabilities are enhanced by four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs providing a total of 128 GB of VRAM. Networking is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth, while local SSD storage is omitted entirely in favor of attached remote block storage.

Benchmark evaluation reveals clear tradeoffs between single-threaded and multi-threaded performance. Single-core CPU tests place the instance in lower performance tiers, recorded via a stress-ng single-core score of 1110.4 and single-threaded gzip compression at 19.36 GB/sec. However, multi-core scaling shows improved resource utilization, achieving a stress-ng multi-core score of 35520.27 and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 147.7 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth performance maintains middle-tier throughput, recording 98.85 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 47.39 GB/sec for large-block writes. Additional application metrics include static web serving throughput at 23.02 GB/sec and Redis SET operations reaching 33.18 million operations per second.

From a hardware density perspective, combining four dedicated V100 GPUs with 368.0 GB of memory makes this instance structurally aligned with deep learning model training, GPU-accelerated scientific simulations, high-throughput video processing, and parallel data analytics. The absence of local storage relies on external network volumes, which should be considered when designing pipelines with heavy local file access requirements. Overall cost efficiency is driven by GPU acceleration density, maximizing multi-GPU execution for parallel tasks where single-core CPU frequency is not the primary performance bottleneck.
